title: ר' יהודה איש טבעים

paragraphs: R. Yehudah of Tevaim says: Sifrei, Haazinu, passage “If they were wise, they would understand this” [locator ער״ל unresolved]. In Sifrei Devarim 323:3 the saying appears under the next verse and names R. Chanina of Tevain. The parallel Yalkut names R. Chananyah of Kefar Tevain. I found written beside it R. Chananyah.
